package.name: wheeltec_mycobot_pick_place_aruco
package.description:
Test package for pick-and-place of an ArUco calibration block.
Pipeline: 1. aruco_ros "single" detects ArUco marker ID 0 (size 0.026m) 2. Marker pose is transformed from camera frame to link1 (arm base) 3. aruco_grasp_node verifies 2-second stable detection 4. MoveIt2 picks the marker block: - move to pre-grasp above marker - slow vertical approach - close gripper - lift ~0.10m - rotate right ~60deg (Z axis) - open gripper (drop block) - return home - wait for next detection The car does not move; only the arm picks in place.
